title: Polydipsia, Polyuria, Unintentional Weight Loss, and Fatigue in Adult

history.chief_complaint: Excessive thirst, drinking 5-6 liters of water daily, frequent urination including 4 times per night
history.onset: Progressive over 4 weeks with 6 kg weight loss

examination_findings.physical_exam: Dry mucous membranes, skin turgor mildly reduced. Acanthosis nigricans noted on posterior neck.

expected_differential_diagnoses.disease_name: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus with Symptomatic Hyperglycemia

missing_features: Hyperglycemia present rules out pure Diabetes Insipidus

expected_followup_questions: Are you experiencing any nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, or fruity breath odor?
Have you noticed any numbness, tingling, or burning sensations in your feet?
Has anyone in your immediate family been diagnosed with diabetes or thyroid conditions?
expected_safety_checks: Verify baseline kidney function (eGFR / Serum Creatinine) prior to Metformin initiation
Screen for diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA) warning signs
expected_do_not_recommend: High-glycemic simple carbohydrate sugary beverages or fruit juices to quench thirst
Metformin initiation without checking baseline renal function (eGFR < 30 mL/min contraindication)
failure_analysis: Diagnosis mismatch (Expected 'None', Top 3 AI: ['viral upper respiratory infection', 'influenza (flu)', 'covid-19'])
